title: Worktree Practice — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Worktree Practice's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: A light face, from the light round of 2026-11, third batch: one small thing beside one sentence, not a walk up to a test. Made by the working session (a child) in Enrichment/light-round-2026-11/, where the makers and data stay; placed here by the Concierge. A challenger has now read this piece (2026-11-11); its verdict is in the section's challenge block. It was made before the challenge of the first forty came back (16 keep, 24 remake), so it likely carries the same kinds of fault that challenge found: a caption that reads more into the page than the page says, a 'what is real' line that owns too little, a count off by one where a parser was naive. Every section is a proposal until Loudon approves it.

pieces.title: The floor moved
pieces.caption: Two sessions in one checkout: one switches the branch, and the other's commit lands on the wrong one. Beside it, a worktree each, and both commits land where they were meant. *What is real and what is a choice:* A schematic of the failure the page was born from, not a record of the commits involved. *Leaking in:* How the Palace Commits.

verdicts.file: Worktree Practice — rich — the floor moved.svg
verdicts.why: It matches the page's own account move for move: one session switches the shared checkout, the other's commit lands on the wrong branch, and a worktree each ends it. "The floor moved" turns "out from under" into something a reader can feel, and the honest line says schematic, not record.
